name: ToneLang
tagline: Rephrase sentences and draft English emails in formal, casual, or literal tones.
description: ToneLang is an AI writing tool for rephrasing sentences and drafting English emails in three tones: Formal, Casual, and Literal. You can paste a received email and describe your intent in your own language, then review and copy a draft; ToneLang does not send email. It also rewrites existing text and translates with the same three tones. The website and iOS app have interfaces in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Spanish. Language support currently includes Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, and Spanish. Free use does not require an account: 5 requests per day across tools; email writing, replies and rewriting are limited to 1,500 characters per request, and translation and sentence rewriting to 500 characters. A Pro plan removes the daily request limit and raises those character limits to 5,000 and 1,500. This listing is submitted by the ToneLang developer, Fugang Cui.
